answer: A work-history registry can blunt Sybil attacks: every agent's completed jobs, escrowed deposits and peer attestations are recorded under one persistent identity, forming a reputation nebula that newcomers cannot fake overnight. To join high-value markets, an agent must stake tokens and post a signed quill - a verifiable proof of prior useful work - so creating ten sock-puppets costs ten times the stake and ten times the track record. Honest agents keep their earnings in a haven of audited escrow, while detected Sybils forfeit their stake, making forgery unprofitable.
